snippet.title: Bubble Rage – The Game You’ll Never Beat | Trailer
snippet.description:
So... you think you're calm?
Bubble Rage is here to prove you wrong.

This solo platformer isn’t hard.
It’s unfair, evil, and absolutely out to get you.

⚠️ Expect:

Impossible jumps

Unforgiving traps

A sudden need to scream into the void

🎮 You won’t beat it.
But you’ll try.
And fail.
And maybe recommend it to your friends… just to watch them suffer too.

💀 Bubble Rage isn’t for the weak.
Play it now — or don’t. We’re not judging (much).
